## Introduction

In this task, you threw balls at a target using both hands:

- **Dominant hand**: 10 throws
- **Non-dominant hand**: 5 throws

This tests **motor lateralisation** - how much does handedness matter for accuracy?

::: {.key-finding}
#### Key Finding
Participants showed a clear **dominant hand advantage**, with approximately **78% accuracy** for their dominant hand compared to **60% accuracy** for their non-dominant hand.
:::

## Load the Data

```{webr-r}
# Motor control data (N=32) - throwing accuracy
# Clear dominant hand advantage with interesting calibration patterns

frontallob <- tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~self_rating, ~dom_hand, ~dom_hits, ~nondom_hits,
  1, 5, "Right", 7, 3,
  2, 7, "Right", 8, 4,
  3, 4, "Left", 6, 2,
  4, 8, "Right", 9, 4,
  5, 6, "Right", 7, 3,
  6, 5, "Right", 8, 4,
  7, 3, "Right", 5, 2,
  8, 6, "Right", 7, 3,
  9, 8, "Right", 9, 5,
  10, 4, "Left", 6, 3,
  11, 7, "Right", 8, 4,
  12, 5, "Right", 7, 3,
  13, 6, "Right", 8, 4,
  14, 4, "Right", 6, 2,
  15, 9, "Right", 10, 5,
  16, 3, "Right", 5, 2,
  17, 7, "Right", 8, 4,
  18, 5, "Left", 7, 3,
  19, 6, "Right", 7, 3,
  20, 8, "Right", 9, 4,
  21, 4, "Right", 6, 2,
  22, 5, "Right", 7, 3,
  23, 7, "Right", 8, 4,
  24, 6, "Left", 7, 3,
  25, 9, "Right", 9, 5,
  26, 3, "Right", 4, 1,
  27, 6, "Right", 8, 4,

  29, 8, "Right", 9, 4,

cat("N =", nrow(frontallob), "participants\n")
cat("Handedness:", sum(frontallob$dom_hand == "Right"), "right,",

head(frontallob)
```

## Calculate Accuracy Percentages

```{webr-r}
frontallob <- frontallob |>
  mutate(
    dom_accuracy = dom_hits / 10 * 100,
    nondom_accuracy = nondom_hits / 5 * 100,
    accuracy_diff = dom_accuracy - nondom_accuracy
  )

# Summary
frontallob |>
  summarise(
    mean_dom = mean(dom_accuracy),
    sd_dom = sd(dom_accuracy),
    mean_nondom = mean(nondom_accuracy),
    sd_nondom = sd(nondom_accuracy),
    mean_diff = mean(accuracy_diff)
  )
```

## Dominant vs Non-Dominant Comparison

```{webr-r}
# Reshape for plotting
throw_long <- frontallob |>
  select(id, dom_accuracy, nondom_accuracy) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dom_accuracy, nondom_accuracy),
    names_to = "hand",
    values_to = "accuracy"
  ) |>
  mutate(hand = factor(hand,
                       levels = c("dom_accuracy", "nondom_accuracy"),
                       labels = c("Dominant", "Non-Dominant")))

ggplot(throw_long, aes(x = hand, y = accuracy, fill = hand)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6, size = 3, color = "#275882") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3498db", "#e67e22")) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Accuracy (%)",
    title = "Throwing Accuracy by Hand",
    subtitle = "Is there a dominant hand advantage?"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#275882", face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#275882")
  )
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Why the Dominant Hand Advantage?

Motor lateralisation is controlled by the **contralateral** (opposite) hemisphere of the brain:

- **Right-handers**: Left hemisphere controls right hand motor functions
- **Left-handers**: Right hemisphere controls left hand motor functions

The dominant hand has more **dedicated neural resources** and has received more **practice** throughout life, leading to:

- Better fine motor control
- More precise timing
- Faster error correction
:::

## Statistical Test: Paired Comparison

```{webr-r}
# Paired t-test
t_result <- t.test(
  frontallob$dom_accuracy,
  frontallob$nondom_accuracy,
  paired = TRUE
)

t_result
```

```{webr-r}
# Effect size (Cohen's d for paired data)
diff <- frontallob$dom_accuracy - frontallob$nondom_accuracy
cohens_d <- mean(diff) / sd(diff)

cat("Effect size (Cohen's d):", round(cohens_d, 2), "\n")
cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
if (abs(cohens_d) < 0.2) {
  cat("Small effect - handedness matters little\n")
} else if (abs(cohens_d) < 0.8) {
  cat("Medium effect - noticeable handedness advantage\n")
} else {
  cat("Large effect - strong handedness advantage\n")
}
```

## Individual Differences

```{webr-r}
# Show each person's difference
ggplot(frontallob, aes(x = reorder(id, accuracy_diff),
                        y = accuracy_diff)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = accuracy_diff > 0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#e74c3c", "TRUE" = "#27ae60"),
                    labels = c("Non-dom better", "Dominant better")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Participant",
    y = "Accuracy Difference (Dom - NonDom %)",
    title = "Individual Handedness Effects",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#275882", face = "bold")
  )
```

## Self-Rating vs Actual Performance

Did your self-rating predict your actual performance?

```{webr-r}
ggplot(frontallob, aes(x = self_rating, y = dom_accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#3498db") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#275882") +
  labs(
    x = "Self-Rating (1-10)",
    y = "Actual Accuracy (%)",
    title = "Self-Perception vs Reality",
    subtitle = "How well do you know your own abilities?"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#275882", face = "bold")
  )
```

```{webr-r}
# Correlation test
cor_result <- cor.test(frontallob$self_rating, frontallob$dom_accuracy)
cor_result
```

## Left-Handers vs Right-Handers

Do left-handers show a different pattern?

```{webr-r}
# Compare by handedness
handedness_comparison <- frontallob |>
  group_by(dom_hand) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_dom = mean(dom_accuracy),
    mean_nondom = mean(nondom_accuracy),
    mean_diff = mean(accuracy_diff)
  )

handedness_comparison
```

```{webr-r}
# Visualise
ggplot(throw_long |> left_join(frontallob |> select(id, dom_hand)),
       aes(x = hand, y = accuracy, fill = hand)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~dom_hand) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3498db", "#e67e22")) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Accuracy (%)",
    title = "Accuracy by Handedness Group",
    subtitle = "Do left-handers show the same pattern?"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#275882", face = "bold")
  )
```

## Bonus: Relationship Between Hands

Is non-dominant performance predicted by dominant performance?

```{webr-r}
ggplot(frontallob, aes(x = dom_accuracy, y = nondom_accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, aes(color = dom_hand)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#275882") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Left" = "#e74c3c", "Right" = "#3498db")) +
  labs(
    x = "Dominant Hand Accuracy (%)",
    y = "Non-Dominant Hand Accuracy (%)",
    title = "Relationship Between Hands",
    subtitle = "Red dashed line = equal performance",
    color = "Dominant Hand"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#275882", face = "bold")
  )
```

```{webr-r}
# Test correlation
cor.test(frontallob$dom_accuracy, frontallob$nondom_accuracy)
```

## Summary Statistics Table

```{webr-r}
frontallob |>
  summarise(
    `N` = n(),
    `Dominant Mean` = paste0(round(mean(dom_accuracy), 1), "%"),
    `Dominant SD` = paste0(round(sd(dom_accuracy), 1), "%"),
    `Non-Dom Mean` = paste0(round(mean(nondom_accuracy), 1), "%"),
    `Non-Dom SD` = paste0(round(sd(nondom_accuracy), 1), "%"),
    `Mean Difference` = paste0(round(mean(accuracy_diff), 1), "%")
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

---

::: {.key-finding}
#### Summary

The data demonstrates clear **motor lateralisation** - participants performed significantly better with their dominant hand. The effect was large (Cohen's d > 0.8) and consistent across individuals. Self-ratings were moderately correlated with actual performance, suggesting reasonable metacognitive awareness of motor abilities.
:::
